_comment: Copy to config/tts.json and pick a provider. tts.json takes precedence over faceless_brand.json tts_voice.

_providers.gcp_studio: Best quality WITH native timestamps (SSML marks). Recommended default.
_providers.gcp_chirp3: Highest quality, most natural. No native timestamps → Whisper used for subtitles.
_providers.gcp_chirp: Very high quality. No native timestamps → Whisper used for subtitles.
_providers.gcp_neural2: Previous default. Good quality, native timestamps.
_providers.edge_tts: Free Microsoft Neural TTS. Fallback when GCP is unavailable.

_note_chirp3_voices: Prefix any name with 'es-ES-Chirp3-HD-' to use it.
